description: Exposed composer.json file revealing PHP project dependencies. Shows the project requires Twig templating engine version 3.20 or higher with development stability preference.
notes: SECURITY FINDING: composer.json is publicly accessible and downloadable. Reveals project dependencies allowing attackers to identify version-specific vulnerabilities. File shows require: twig/twig ^3.20, minimum-stability: dev, prefer-stable: true. This indicates the project is under development.
